basic_profile.bio: I'm a first-year college student at Rutgers, currently exploring different majors with an interest in computer science and psychology. Originally from New Jersey, I love spending time outdoors and exploring new tech gadgets. I'm usually online in the evenings after classes, around 8 PM to midnight. I work part-time as a barista and am single, focusing on my studies and personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of computer science from my coursework and enjoy learning about psychology through online articles and discussions. I'm also keen on following the latest trends in technology and music.
